overview_description.description: Tweeks is an AI-powered browser extension that lets users customize how websites look and behave using natural language. The product allows users to describe desired changes in plain English, then generates and applies browser userscripts to restyle pages, hide elements, add features, or adjust layouts. Tweeks supports modifications across many popular sites and works with Chromium-based browsers and Firefox. Users can install community-created tweeks from a public library or create their own without writing JavaScript or understanding browser APIs. Each modification runs as a sandboxed userscript, and users can enable, disable, or remove tweeks on specific sites. Tweeks also exposes source code for public tweeks and maintains supporting services such as an online dashboard, documentation, and an engineering blog.
